mkdir -p /Users/carter/dev/agentvillage-cp-wt/data-259-review/control-plane/src/migrations && cat > /Users/carter/dev/agentvillage-cp-wt/data-259-review/control-plane/src/migrations/0030_approval_reviews.sql <<'EOF'
-- DATA-259: the resident's onboarding review of their approval.md settings
-- (control-plane/src/approval-review.js; docs/APPROVAL-REVIEW.md). One row per
-- tenant, the settings the control plane renders into the resident's policy:
--
-- - inferred_intents, village_question, digest_sharing: the three policy
--   switches (S1..S3), whose values pick the autonomy of
--   intent.publish.inferred.index, village.vote and digest.share. The root
--   step (approvald.js ensurePolicy) renders from these, so an update or a
--   recreate keeps what the resident chose; no row means the template's
--   defaults (ask, draft, ask), byte-identical to DATA-250's render.
-- - receipt: the S1 receipt preference the morning brief reads (DATA-222);
--   derived from inferred_intents, stored so a reader needs no rule.
-- - quiet_hours: S4, the Telegram relay's quiet window for this tenant:
--   {"start":"HH:MM","end":"HH:MM","time_zone":"Area/City"} or {"off":true};
--   NULL is the village default (APPROVAL_RELAY_QUIET_DEFAULT).
-- - edgeos_id: the resident's EdgeOS /humans/me id as the app reported it,
--   the policy's approvers.resident.senders.edgeos once the channel is
--   rendered. Operational data, beside tenants.telegram_user_id; never sent
--   to ingest (the event carries an HMAC of it).
-- - policy_sha256, mode, accepted, attested_by, reviewed_at: the latest
--   review's outcome (the resident's log is the record of truth).
--
-- Locks: a new table only. The previous release runs unchanged beside it:
-- nothing it reads or writes names it. Down step:
-- migrations/down/0030_approval_reviews.sql (not run by migrate).

-- As in 0017: give up on a held lock after 5 s; LOCAL ends with this file's batch.
SET LOCAL lock_timeout = '5s';
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS approval_reviews (
  tenant_id UUID PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES tenants(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  inferred_intents TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ask' CHECK (inferred_intents IN ('ask', 'publish_then_tell', 'publish')),
  village_question TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK (village_question IN ('draft', 'answer', 'abstain')),
  digest_sharing TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ask' CHECK (digest_sharing IN ('ask', 'share', 'never')),
  receipt TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none' CHECK (receipt IN ('none', 'morning_brief')),
  quiet_hours JSONB NULL,
  edgeos_id TEXT NULL CHECK (edgeos_id ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,127}$'),
  policy_sha256 TEXT NULL CHECK (policy_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
  mode TEXT NULL CHECK (mode IN ('recorded', 'relay')),
  accepted BOOLEAN NULL,
  attested_by TEXT NULL CHECK (attested_by IN ('operator', 'resident')),
  reviewed_at TIMESTAMPTZ NULL,
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
EOF
cat > /Users/carter/dev/agentvillage-cp-wt/data-259-review/control-plane/src/migrations/down/0030_approval_reviews.sql <<'EOF'
-- Down step for 0030_approval_reviews.sql. Not read by migrate.js. Run by hand:
--   psql "$DATABASE_URL" -f control-plane/src/migrations/down/0030_approval_reviews.sql
-- Deploy a release without the onboarding review first: its root step reads
-- approval_reviews to render the resident's policy. What is lost: the
-- residents' settings on the control-plane side. Their policies in force are
-- untouched (they live in each sandbox's store), but the next root step on an
-- operator-attested store renders the template's defaults again.

BEGIN;
-- Give up on a held lock after 5 s rather than queue every query behind it.
SET LOCAL lock_timeout = '5s';
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS approval_reviews;
DELETE FROM schema_migrations WHERE name = '0030_approval_reviews.sql';
COMMIT;
EOF
